research_object: Late-time cosmic expansion and logically separate vacuum-stability outcomes.
constraints: Keep observational history, asymptotic continuation, and fate event distinct.
Do not claim a present observation of a future endpoint.
Do not merge false-vacuum decay with the Friedmann expansion result.
Every selected idea must expose a falsification condition and a target gap ID.

recommended_seed.title: A conditional cosmic-fate ledger rather than a universal death clock
recommended_seed.mechanism: Map declared model family and asymptotic assumptions to H(a), a fate class, an evidence status, and a future discriminator.
recommended_seed.observable_anchor: CMB, BAO, supernova, growth, redshift-drift, and standard-siren constraints as available.
